blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes for small businesses can sound hard. But in English, they follow simple patterns. The words are short and easy. Today we learn five useful adjectives: small, simple, quick, easy and friendly.

Sophie works at Czarnikow. She helps the team with taxes. She uses easy words, so everyone can understand. The forms are small. The steps are quick. Sophie is friendly and she explains slowly, in simple English.

Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. One small step at a time, taxes become easier. You do not need difficult words — you need the right words. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "Sophie works at Czarnikow."

items.q: How does Sophie explain taxes?
items.why: "she explains slowly, in simple English."

items.q: What five adjectives does the text teach?
items.why: "five useful adjectives: small, simple, quick, easy and friendly."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Sophie's easy words help the team.
Small business taxes follow simple patterns.
One small step at a time helps.
You need difficult words to talk about taxes.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "You do not need difficult words — you need the right words."

items.q: "One small step at a time" suggests that…
options: taxes get easier little by little
items.why: Inferência: passo a passo, com calma, os impostos ficam mais fáceis.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie explicando os impostos das pequenas empresas para a equipe. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, everyone. My name is Sophie. Today I want to talk about our taxes. Please do not worry. It is easy, I promise.

Our company is small. So our forms are small too. There are only a few papers. The steps are quick and clear. First, we fill out the form. We write our name and the numbers. Then we check the numbers one more time. After that, we hand it in. That is all. Three simple steps.

I know taxes can sound hard. But in English, the words are simple. Small, quick, easy — these are the words we use every day. You already know them. So you know more than you think.

If you have a question, please come to me. I am here to help. I am friendly, and there are no bad questions. We work together, one small step at a time.

The deadline is next Friday. That is soon, but we have time. So let's stay calm, let's keep it simple, and let's do it as a team. Thank you very much.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's message about taxes at the start?
options: Do not worry, it is easy
It is very hard this year
items.why: "Please do not worry. It is easy."

items.q: What is the FIRST step Sophie describes?
items.why: "First, we fill out the form."

items.q: When is the deadline?
items.why: "The deadline is next Friday."

items.q: Why does Sophie say "You already know them"?
options: The tax words are simple and common
items.why: Inferência: as palavras (small, quick, easy) são simples e do dia a dia, por isso a equipe já as conhece.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela tranquiliza a equipe, se oferece para ajudar e diz "one step at a time".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our company is small, so the forms are short." Small means…
items.why: Small = pequeno, não grande.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The tax form is ___. It has only three questions."
items.why: Simple = simples; poucas perguntas, fácil de responder.

items.q: "The process is quick — five minutes and it is done." Quick means…
items.why: Quick = rápido.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Do not worry. This step is very ___, not difficult."
items.why: Easy = fácil, o contrário de difficult.

items.q: "Sophie is friendly; she smiles and helps everyone." Friendly means…
items.why: Friendly = amigável, simpática.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em conversas sobre impostos e formulários. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "First, we fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher (escrever os dados no formulário).

items.q: "Please hand in the form before Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar (dar o documento a quem recebe).

items.q: "The accountant will sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We keep track of every payment in a folder." To keep track of means to…
items.why: Keep track of = acompanhar, manter o controle.

items.q: "Let's send the form on time." On time means…
options: at the right moment, not late
items.why: On time = no prazo, na hora certa.
